title: AegisAI, founded by former Google security execs, lands $36M to stop AI-driven spear phishing
summary: AegisAI co-founders developed AI agents that quickly analyze each message as a human would, paying attention to small anomalies that even the most elaborate checklist wouldn’t catch.
llm_summary: AegisAI, a cybersecurity startup co-founded by former Google security executives, has secured $36 million in funding to combat AI-driven spear phishing attacks. The company's AI-powered technology analyzes emails like a human would, catching subtle anomalies that traditional security checks often miss. This approach aims to provide more effective protection against sophisticated phishing threats.
